follow_for.description: How many seconds to follow, 1 to 3,600: 10 if not said.

frames.description: Frames to let pass after the steps, with no input.

log_since.description:
The first log line to answer, by its number: 0 for every line kept,
the last answer's `log_next` for the lines since.

perf_follow.description:
A file to follow the build's frames into (from the working folder):
each new frame's record written as a line as the build runs, for
`follow_for` seconds or until the build quits.

perf_since.description:
The first frame's record to answer, by its number, if wanted: 0
for every record kept, the last answer's `perf_next` for the
records since. With `perf_follow`, where the following starts.

screenshot.description:
Where to write the window's picture, a PNG file (from the working
folder), if wanted.

steps.description:
The steps to play, in order: waits in seconds, played as the build's
frames at 60 a second, rounded up; no crank.

token.description: The token the build logged when it started listening.

Step.description: One step of a script, played in the order written.

oneOf.description:
Each whitespace-separated key chord pressed in one frame and let go
in the next, in turn (`"Enter Up Shift+Space"`).

Each whitespace-separated controller button pressed in one frame
and let go in the next, in turn (`"South"`; `"East+DpadDown"`:
those buttons together).

The game's action of that name (`Confirm`), pressed by the player's
primary key for it, or its primary button if it has no key.
That many seconds of frames with no input, 60 a second, rounded up.

The crank wound that many degrees in one frame (backwards is
negative), as a Playdate front end reports it.

Debug tools and the debug view's channels of these comma-separated
ids turned on from here on (`"grid,collision"`; `"all"` turns on
every channel, offered or not), and the frame drawn again: no frame
passes (ADR-0084). Played by the Harness only.
